'''Moss Giant Island''' is a small island located west of [[Brimhaven]], accessed by using a rope swing ([[Rope]] not needed) requiring 10 [[Agility]]. There are five [[moss giant]]s on the island. Players can use [[safespot]]s when fighting them.    

There are two [[slice of cake]] [[Spawning|spawns]], which have a respawn time of 45 seconds. Players with 40+ [[Defence]] do not need to bring much [[food]] because of this resource. Lower-level players should, however, be cautious of the [[Poison Scorpion]]s near the island.  

The island is also a [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scroll]] step location.

==Transportation==
* [[Brimhaven teleport]] or [[Teleport to house]] (if your house is in Brimhaven) and run west.
* Brimhaven spirit tree and run west.
* Fairy ring {{Fairycode|BJR}}, then blowing the [[magic whistle]] obtained during the [[Holy Grail]] quest.
* [[Ardougne teleport]], run south-east to [[Captain Barnaby]], travel to Brimhaven for 30 [[coins]], run west.
